# StackPlanner BrowseComp+ Search SOP

1. Decompose the public question into identifying clues and targeted searches.
2. Use only the injected read-only Search tool; never use a shell or arbitrary web access.
3. Join evidence across retrieved documents and discard unsupported candidates.
4. Cite only docids actually returned by Search, inline as `[docid]`.
5. Submit a succinct exact answer, grounded explanation, citations, and confidence.
